questions.prompt: Opportunity cost is best described as:
choices: The next best alternative you gave up
questions.rationale: Opportunity cost is the value of the best alternative forgone, not the cash outlay.

questions.prompt: If demand rises and supply is unchanged, price usually:
questions.rationale: More demand against the same supply pushes the equilibrium price up.

questions.prompt: In one line, what does inflation do to the purchasing power of money?
questions.model_answer: It reduces it — each unit of money buys less over time.
questions.rationale: Inflation is a sustained rise in the general price level, lowering purchasing power.
